2.w: “Does a wise man answer with blustery knowledge, or fill his belly with the east wind?

3.w: Does he argue with useless talk, with words that have no value in them?

4.w: But you even break off piety and hinder meditation before God.

5.w: Your sin inspires your mouth; you choose the language of the crafty.

6.w: Your own mouth condemns you, not I; your own lips testify against you.

7.w: “Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?

8.w: Do you listen in on God’s secret council? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

9.w: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand that we don’t understand?

10.w: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, men far older than your father.

11.w: Are God’s consolations too trivial for you, or a word spoken in gentleness to you?

12.w: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,

13.w: when you turn your rage against God and allow such words to escape from your mouth?

14.w: What is man that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?

15.w: If God places no trust in his holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in his eyes,

16.w: how much less man, who is abominable and corrupt, who drinks in evil like water!

17.w: I will explain to you; listen to me, and what I have seen, I will declare,

18.w: what wise men declare, hiding nothing, from the tradition of their ancestors,

19.w: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.

20.w: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, throughout the number of the years that are stored up for the tyrant.

21.w: Terrifying sounds fill his ears; in a time of peace marauders attack him.

22.w: He does not expect to escape from darkness; he is marked for the sword;

23.w: he wanders about—food for vultures — he knows that the day of darkness is at hand.

24.w: Distress and anguish terrify him; they prevail against him like a king ready to launch an attack,

25.w: for he stretches out his hand against God, and vaunts himself against the Almighty,

26.w: defiantly charging against him with a thick, strong shield!

27.w: Because he covered his face with fat and made his hips bulge with fat,

28.w: he lived in ruined towns and in houses where no one lives, where they are ready to crumble into heaps.

29.w: He will not grow rich, and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.

30.w: He will not escape the darkness; a flame will wither his shoots, and he will depart by the breath of God’s mouth.

31.w: Let him not trust in what is worthless, deceiving himself; for worthlessness will be his reward.

32.w: Before his time he will be paid in full, and his branches will not flourish.

33.w: Like a vine he will let his sour grapes fall, and like an olive tree he will shed his blossoms.

34.w: For the company of the godless is barren, and fire consumes the tents of those who accept bribes.

35.w: They conceive trouble and bring forth evil; their belly prepares deception.”
